description: The trail winds its way from Hwy 3 and near Wilgress Lake from and elevation of +/- 1022 meters along a ridge to Thimble Mtn. with an elevation of +/- 1310 meters and down to the rail Trail to an elevation of +/- 804 meters. Witn views of the Northfork Valley.
directions: To Access the trail traveling west form Grand Forks BC on Hwy 3 for approx. +/- 23.2 km then turn easterly onto Upper Fisherman FSr for +/- 270 meters and then onto Wilgress Lake Road for +/- 497 meters will get you to the trails head.
title: Thimble Mtn
